verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform that holds merchant and transaction data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The axis therefore applies. The evidence pack covers only API keys, sandbox, webhooks, onboarding, pricing, payouts, disputes and white-labeling, with nothing on AI training or a data-use opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
